comment: Yes, he is a great teacher. Yes, he tries to make class more interesting. However, it is already a hard subject, and he makes it 10x harder on purpose. Tests are INSANE. He puts things on it that you will never have seen before and expects you to figure it out, which may work for some people, but not me. Take someone else.

Hands down the best professor I've ever had. Tests are HARD - I would start studying at least 2 weeks in advance. Averages are usually 70s but he scales. He teaches you how to think rather than memorize. So accessible outside of class and lectures are so entertaining. Genuinely changed the trajectory of my academic career.
Great professor! Keeps classes fun with stories and keeps you engaged. Tests are brutal, require lots of studying. He curves the class based on test grades so as long as you study you will be fine.

Great Prof, very funny. Orgo is hard, but you got this. Dr Downey is great at explaining complex topics and is generally a nice person who cares about his students and works hard to help them understand. I had him for orgo 1 and 2, by far the best prof I have had at UR. The exams are brutal; start studying at least 2 weeks in advance.

Incredibly challenging course, even more incredible prof. Always accessible, it gives you plenty of material to practice with, and the lectures were genuinely so entertaining. This course is a beast, do not take it lightly, keep up with HW, ask questions, and go to office hours! Exams are tough.

By far my favorite prof I have had at UR!

Dr. Downey is hilarious and so incredibly smart. I learned a lot from his class. His tests are really difficult compared to some other professors, which led to quite a low grade for me. Prepare to study weeks in advance for exams that are basically your entire grade.

Downey is a good lecturer and provides a lot of study material. He also curves the tests though based on class average. However, his tests are difficult, especially compared to some of the other professors. I liked him decent enough. I chose to take him twice because he has lecture videos and notes on blackboard and a lot of practice tests.

The best professor at Richmond - hilarious, engaging, and incredibly intelligent! I had him for both Orgo 1 and 2, and he made difficult material incredibly simple and easy to digest. His grading is fair and includes a generous scale. When our class underperformed on an exam, he offered corrections to earn points back. Take organic with Downey!!

Downey is great! tests can be challenging and orgo can just be hard, but he is clear about what will be on tests and makes a fair grading scale so getting a good grade in the class is very possible. He provides recorded lectures and lecture notes prior to class and provides feedback on homework problems every class. highly recommended his class.

Dr. Downey is an awesome professor. He is hilarious. he brought out his guitar for the last day of class. He teaches very well. His exams are hard, but they are not unfair. You will definitely have a challenge, but he's the goat.

Wade is the funniest professor I have ever had. He teaches really well and has clear expectations. If you put the work in, it is easy to have a good grade in his class. I am taking his class again for CHEM 206 and would recommend him to anybody.

Downey is one of the most hilarious professors out there for Chem 205. Unlike some, he ensured that all the material is learned, even if class has to start a little bit earlier. Tests are difficult due to there being a low amount of questions, but he prepares you well if you take the time! He gives old tests and does review sessions for each test.

Incredible prof and great guy. Orgo is a super hard class but Downey does everything he can to make it manageable and fun. If (big if) you put in the work you will likely succeed. Only three tests and a final but he gives tons of partial credit and opportunity for extra credit of he feels like it is necessary. If your scared to take orgo don't be.

Dr. Downey's lectures were clear and about as entertaining as orgo will get. Grading was strict but fair individually, but his overall grading scheme was somewhat confusing and unfair. It was much more forgiving for under-performers than those above average.

Downey is a great professor if you put the work in. It is not an easy class, but if you put in effort, go to office hours, show up every class, an A is very achievable. He gives lots of practice tests, extra problems, and homework is based on completion. Grade is very test heavy, about 78% of ur grade. If u plan on doing 206, his class is great.

It's a hard course, but Downey gives very clear expectations and plenty of practice tests to help prepare for exams. He gives clear lectures and is responsive to questions. I'm taking him again for CHEM 206 because his class provides a clear structure for a difficult course.

Downey was a good teacher for a really difficult course. Orgo 2 contains a lot of memorization so definitely practice over the course of the semester (unlike what I did). His tests are hard and compared to other chem teachers at UR he is on the harder side. I would take him again.

Great lecturer and accessible outside of class. He is very approachable and willing to adjust to your schedule. Difficult tests and classes require studying for tens of hours for tests and at least a week in advance. Good luck; Orgo is hard, but with Downey, you should be okay.

Downey is probably the best professor I have had so far. Even though the class is difficult and your grade is based on 3 tests, the exam, and lab, he grades fairly and gives plenty of resources to use to review for the tests. He is very organized in the way he teaches, and he lectures efficiently with some childhood stories and jokes thrown in.

Dr. Downey is by far the most amusing Chem prof. you will ever have, and he makes a dense subject entertaining. Every lecture is clear and makes sure to give you exposure to all types of problems, making tests easy to study for. He is a very fair grader, and he does not ever give trick questions. Lectures are the most organized I've ever seen.

I had Dr. Downey for Orgo II. His lectures went by fast in the shorter 50 minclasses. There isn't much homework, but there is ample practice for the tests. I always felt prepared when I took his tests as he offers 4 practice exams for every test in the class. He always makes sure to expose you to the hardest problems before tests so you are ready.

One of my favorite professors. Very organized and wants students to succeed. Tests are difficult but he gives lot of study resources and they reflect class content accurately. Every class is a lecture, but he's very funny and 50 minute classes are doable.

This class is extremely challenging, but Dr. Downey does a great job in lectures and outside of class helping you understand the material. His tests are hard. You have to put in the time and effort in order to do well. He is always available to answer questions. Participation is required and recommended, though his lecture materials are available.

Dr. Downey is such a good teacher. I was super nervous for orgo but if you put in the work you will do well in the class. Downey does a really good job of making class engaging and held review sessions before each test. I 100% recommend him and am so excited to have him for CHEM206!

he is the most amazing professor a the University of Richmond. He is funny, makes organic chemistry a nice class to go to. Explains everything clearly, and helps you be 100% prepared for tests. If you use the materials he gives you, you will get a good grade

I had Dr. Downey for 205 and 206 and I can't recommend him enough. SOOOO funny. He has the best stories in lecture and is a true gem. Make orgs (which can be dry) very engaging!!! You have put in the work to study for tests and stay on top of the material. Tests can be hard but he always has a fair curve.

Dr. Downey did the best he could teaching us a very difficult subject. While his lesson plans were complete and had been successful in previous semesters, our class had an average of 60-something on all three unit exams and the final. Something was not clicking for many students, and it seemed like Dr. Downey didnt quite know how to handle that.

Dr. Downey is truly the best! I am so sad that I don't have the opportunity to take him next semester for 206. His lectures are so clear for a topic that is very difficult. The practice tests that he gives out are so helpfully. I would recommend doing them and going to his review sessions because they help a lot for the tests! Just amazing guy!

Dr. Downey is seriously one of the best professors I've ever had. I think most people are scared of orgo, but he gave useful assignments and made the class fun. No busy work, all of the homework helps you learn the material. He gives tons of practice tests that are very similar to the real tests, so if you study it is not hard to do well.

Great professor, you wont regret taking his classes. His lectures are entertaining yet well explained, so you dont have to worry about falling asleep on accident (gotty air conditioning does that imo). The only thing to note is definitely study extensively for the exams. The exams are basically everything. Ask him questions, and do practice probs.

I've only been in this class for a few weeks but I already Love Dr. Downey. Not only is he very funny but I now understand concepts that I was stuck on in 141. I can tell the class is getting more difficult but new concepts are explained very well and we have just enough homework to help clarify and practice them without feeling like busywork

Quality of teaching was amazing. He provides students with challenging material and acknowledges effort. Yes, the material and tests were difficult, but Dr. Downey is super approachable during class and office hours. I will definitely take him for the next level of Chemistry!!

Dr. Downey is an amazing professor. He definitely gives difficult tests but he makes you work hard for them. Definitely is not an easy A but if you put in the effort you will do good. Highly recommend
Best professor I've had at the University of Richmond. I would definitely take him again for both Organic I and II. Can be tough, but his curve is fair, and the class is an experience.

Dr. D is great at his job and is extremely approachable if you're lost or confused. There are other Orgo professors who are considered just as good, but Downey's class is an experience. Unfortunately, he's extremely hard, so be prepared to do a lot of work and practice but if you put in the work, you'll get an A.

Difficult course. Difficult tests. Amazing professor. He knows what he's talking about and does his absolute best to make everyone  understand. His tests are mostly application, meaning it's not enough to understand and explain the topics, but  you need to answer a variety of questions on them. You might fail but you won't regret taking him.
He's awesome. Take him. You might fail, but He's amazing. He, because He deserves a capital H.  Actually though.

Dr. Downey is an excellent teacher in lecture and goes out of his way to make sure he is available outside of class if you want help. Tests are pretty challenging but if you study very hard you should do okay. Great guy though
super nice, and helpful, smart, good at teaching the material

Great teacher and always willing to help out if you go to him. Some people consider him a hard teacher, but if you really know chemistry and are willing to put in the effort to study an A is definitely possible.

Dr. Downey is a great teacher...but he is a little confusing at times even though he outlines all of his notes during lecture. Tests are pretty difficult. If you want to do well in this class, read every night and review your notes! He really cares about helping students to improve and get better test scores.

One of the best chemistry professors at UR. I loved the class. Downey is challenging but is always willing to give extra guidance. He makes organic interesting, not an easy task. His tests are hard though. Lecture was a breeze and so were the homework problems but I still struggled a bit on his exams.

Best. Chemistry. Teacher. Ever. As difficult as the subject can be, Wade won't let you down. He's very helpful, very engaging (hint: puppet shows), and made chemistry easily my favorite subject. Difficult tests but relaxed grader, curves to an extent, and if you get an A on the final you get an A in the class. Pay attention in class!

Can't say enough great things about Dr. Downey. His passion for the subject has a funny way of making everyone else enjoy Organic Chemistry. UR picked up a gem in Dr. Downey as a person, teacher, and advisor. I would't want to have anyone else teach me Organic Chemistry.

Brilliant teacher. I didn't think I would love chemistry so much, but his passion has a way of rubbing off on his students. He is always available for extra help, and brings his own spark to teaching. He is funny, engaging, and wants his students to do well. He is by far my favorite teacher. Test are definitely tough, but the work is worth it.

Dr. Downey is a challenging professor but believe me, you will come out more stronger because of it. I took him for CHEM 205 and while it was the most challenging class I ever took, CHEM 206 was a breeze because of it. He's also really helpful and provides review sessions prior to each test. Tests are HARD though. You WILL work hard in this class.

Dr. Downey outlines all the material you need for the class. He is very helpful and encourages students to come to office hours to ask their questions. He also offers review sessions before tests. His exams are very challenging but he curves the class accordingly.

Dr. Downey is easily one of the best chemistry teachers. He's funny, helpful and actually cares if you understand. Do the homework, it's collected and very useful. Don't bother with the textbook. Tests are hard but doable if you study, and his grading is very fair. Highly recommend taking his class!

He is a wonderful teacher. Passionate and interesting. He makes jokes all throughout class and he is always willing to help, especially around test time. There are no quizzes and tests come straight from notes. Its important to do the homework: its always collected and its helpful. he is fun in lab also. Taught 20 students without a TA

Dr. Downey can be tough at times, but if you pay good attention to his lectures, it is virtually impossible to do poorly in his class. His test curves are wonderful as well. Overall excellent teachers, and I definitely am going to take him for Chem 206 next semester.

Wade is kind of crazy but he made orgo bareable at 8 in the morning. Just study the notes very well and do practice problems and HWs: then you will get a really good grade. just put in the effort and youll be rewarded

Dr. Downey is amazing! I had heard horrible things about organic chemistry, but because he is such a fantastic teacher it was actually my favorite class. He is a quiet guy, but has a quirky sense of humor that I found hilarious. He gives excellent notes, and is extremely helpful before tests (hard, but definitely not impossible). A+ teacher!!!

wade is incredible, one of the best teachers here by far and i think most of the teachers ive had were pretty good. he is clear and always makes things interesting, not to mention he knows a lot about the most random things and will definitely keep you laughing. do your work though because it's a hard class!

Wade is one of my favorite teachers at Richmond. I didn't like chemistry at all before his class, but he has an excellent teaching style and really makes the material interesting. I learned so much in just one semester.  His tests ARE hard, but he grades on a curve so it all works out.  He's incredibly approachable and wants his students to do well

wade is the man. i would change my major to chem if he taught every class. he made the material much more interesting and kept you on the edge of ur seat. i didnt mind going for class on TR. hes awesome..EVERYONE should take him.

He was both hilarious and informative.  I had him on TR and I only almost fell asleep once.  His tests are hard, but if you study the notes and homeworks, the tests aren't that bad.  Downey is a piece of work.  Be prepared to laugh, even if you hate chem with a passion
